dedupe_keys.name: a multi resolution geospatial dataset of monsoon flood extent and spatial clustering for pakistan 2022 2025

description: Abdullah Umer publishes a Pakistan flood-exposure dataset for the 2022–2025 monsoon seasons. Zenodo offers CSV tables, GeoPackage layers, a variable dictionary and an R processing notebook under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The deposit joins satellite-detected flood polygons with 160 district and 577 tehsil units and reports flooded area, share of unit area, hot-spot class and spatial-association class by year. A modeller can use these layers to validate flood exposure or prioritise roads, health facilities and utilities for resilience scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this four-season administrative aggregation. A limitation is that it records mapped extents and derived statistics, not flood depths or exact losses at individual assets. Flood detection and boundary quality, as well as varying administrative-unit sizes, affect comparison. No file was downloaded, and the R processing or spatial statistics were not reproduced.
